name: Macau - Zhuhai
scopeLimits: 28 valid, distinct official Cad_lote parcel polygons verified in thirteen local cells around the explicit in-Macao center [22.1940052, 113.5442146]. Complete pages, fresh exact-ID hashes, absence, footprint and source binding pass, with no sampled overlaps above 0.01 m². This covers the Macao side of the Macau–Zhuhai settlement only. The ranked WUP point is outside Macao SAR; Zhuhai and wider municipal coverage remain unverified.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official DSCC cadastral viewer exposes the public Cad_lote polygon service, and a bounded anonymous query near the Macao urban reference returned a parcel. The repository adapter passed its 13-cell qualification and follow-up checks on that nearby Macao area. Macao’s official boundary excludes the ranked locator; Zhuhai’s official registry homepage links a map-property lookup that redirects to Guangdong identity authentication, so no Zhuhai geometry was verified.

executedQueries.query: 澳门 官方 地籍图 地籍资讯网 地籍信息查询 地块 土地工务局 site:dsscu.gov.mo OR site:gis.gov.mo
executedQueries.scope: Find official Macao cadastral information and an online parcel map or service.
executedQueries.result: Official DSCC/Cartography and Cadastre sources identify the Rede de Informação Cadastral / 地籍資訊網 at cadastre.gis.gov.mo. The web map is a separate viewer; its downloaded app bundle identifies public basemaps and thematic services, but no parcel geometry endpoint. The cadastral information page routes to jurisdiction-specific lookup/procedure; no public geometry sample was confirmed.
executedQueries.executionMethod: Separate Chinese-language search; official Chinese service page and cadastral viewer shell/app bundle reviewed.

executedQueries.query: Macau cadastro predial mapa oficial Direcção dos Serviços de Cartografia e Cadastro terrenos
executedQueries.scope: Cross-check in Portuguese whether cadastral map information and parcel geometry are publicly accessible.
executedQueries.result: The official Portuguese service page describes Macao cadastral-plan application through DSCC and requires proof of rights and an in-person procedure. The official Macao boundary is north of the relevant point, so this procedure is not a point-scope result for the WUP locator.
executedQueries.executionMethod: Separate Portuguese-language search and official service page review; no gated record was requested.

executedQueries.query: Macau Zhuhai official cadastral parcel map land registry public GIS service Zhuhai Natural Resources Bureau
executedQueries.scope: Independently check English-language official sources for the Macau–Zhuhai compound label and locate Zhuhai cadastral/registry services for the ranked point.
executedQueries.result: The English-language search returned official Macao DSCC and cadastral-network sources but no English-language official Zhuhai cadastral parcel map. Zhuhai-specific searches and the City Real Estate Registration Center official site identify a comprehensive online property-information query; its public HTML link opens a JavaScript-only page, and no anonymous geometry result at the exact ranked point was verified.
executedQueries.executionMethod: Separate English-language web search followed by official Zhuhai Real Estate Registration Center and Natural Resources Bureau pages and the center’s linked query page.

executedQueries.scope: Find official Zhuhai natural-resource/cadastral map services relevant to the ranked locator.
executedQueries.result: The official Zhuhai Natural Resources Bureau site was confirmed. It does not expose a public parcel geometry service in the inspected page. The related Zhuhai Real Estate Registration Center provides an official comprehensive online property-information query link, but its JavaScript-only page did not produce a public parcel response.
executedQueries.executionMethod: Separate Chinese-language search and inspection of official Zhuhai municipal sources.

executedQueries.scope: Locate the Zhuhai local property registry and any public cadastral-map lookup.
executedQueries.result: The official Zhuhai Real Estate Registration Center page links “不动产综合信息查询” (comprehensive real-estate information query) hosted by www.zhbdc.org.cn. The linked page displays a JavaScript-required message in a text-only inspection; no anonymous feature-service or geometry result was verified.
executedQueries.executionMethod: Separate Chinese-language search, official homepage link inspection, and linked-page review.

officialSources.observation: Official DSCC Chinese-language services page lists the cadastral information network and online map systems.
Official 地籍資訊網 landing page. Map hotspots lead to port/main.html pages; the landing HTML has no public ArcGIS parcel API or feature layer.
Separate official online-map shell (Chinese/English variants load /MapGIS/js/app.js and chunk-vendors.js).
Downloaded active viewer application bundle; discovered thematic mapping services and link back to the cadastral information site, but no cadastral parcel feature service.
Official Macao government Portuguese service entry for cadastral plan; states application conditions including proof of rights and personal/in-person procedure.
Official Macao Gazette boundary notice defines the administrative boundary in geographic coordinates; its northernmost land boundary point is 22°13′01.33″N.
Official Macao Yearbook states the territory’s northern limit is 22°13′01.33″N; the ranked WUP locator latitude 22.26121145 is north of that latitude and therefore outside Macao SAR.
Official Zhuhai Real Estate Registration Center page identifies the local registry operator and links “不动产综合信息查询” at www.zhbdc.org.cn.
Official Zhuhai Natural Resources Bureau site reviewed; no public parcel geometry endpoint was exposed in the inspected page.
Official Zhuhai registry-center-linked query page displays a JavaScript-required message in text-only inspection; no anonymous geometry response was obtained.

Active official Portuguese cadastral viewer loads ../js/mgis.js?lang=P and the layer-query scripts. The discovered Cad_lote/MapServer/0 polygon endpoint was queried at the exact ranked point with OBJECTID-only attributes and returned an empty feature array; the point is outside Macao SAR.

Point query against the active official lot polygon layer returned an empty features array. The result is consistent with the ranked point lying outside the Macao SAR boundary; it does not demonstrate that Macao’s lot geometry is generally unavailable.

viewerAndServiceTrace.pointQueryResult: Ranked WUP locator query: HTTP 200 and empty features. Separate nearby Macao urban point [22.1940052,113.5442146]: HTTP 200, one Polygon (OBJECTID 389) from Cad_lote/0, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326.
viewerAndServiceTrace.jurisdictionFinding: The official Macao Yearbook and Notice 128/2015 place Macao’s northern limit at 22°13′01.33″N; ranked point latitude is 22.26121145 and is outside Macao. The empty Macao parcel query at the ranked point is therefore not used to assess Zhuhai geometry.
viewerAndServiceTrace.zhuhaiLookup: Official registry-center page links a “以图查房” map-property-search route at https://www.zhbdc.org.cn/zhshim/MapIndex/Main. An ordinary unauthenticated GET redirects to the Guangdong government identity service (client_id gdrz_zhbdcdj). No login or authenticated query was performed.

adapterQualification.details: Full bounded repository-adapter QA passed in temporary files: complete viewport retrieval, forced page-size-3 pagination with hash equality, fresh-ID reads, explicit absence, footprint query, and complete source binding.
